style: Wide plate for the opening title cards of an art film. Layered paper-collage and steel-engraving texture fused with old photography: visible paper grain, foxing, fine cross-hatching, deep chiaroscuro, muted earth palette (bone, charcoal, dusty ochre, faded indigo). The composition must leave the TOP-LEFT corner empty and dark for a small index number, and the CENTRE-LOWER third calm and low-detail for a large title. Cinematic 16:9. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO WATERMARK, NO BORDER.

items.name: era01_ionia
items.prompt: Aegean coastline at dusk, dark sea and a low fire on broken stone ruins, distant hills, elemental water and fire, almost no figures.

items.name: era02_cave_academy
items.prompt: The mouth of a cave on the left opening onto a sunlit marble colonnade on the right, two worlds joined by a shaft of light.

items.name: era03_gothic
items.prompt: Interior of a gothic cathedral, immense shafts of light through clerestory windows, empty nave, stone floor in shadow.

items.name: era04_slate_mirror
items.prompt: A wax tablet and a hand mirror side by side on a dark table, with a faint geometric diagram incised in the wood between them.

items.name: era05_bastille
items.prompt: Ruins of a stone fortress at dawn, broken chains and rubble, a torn flag on a pike, smoke low on the ground.

items.name: era06_factory_book
items.prompt: Interior of a nineteenth-century factory, iron gears and belts in the dark, a single open book resting on a machine, dust in a shaft of light.

items.name: era07_winterpalace
items.prompt: A long palace corridor at night, marble columns, a red banner hanging, snow light through tall windows, empty.

items.name: era08_lab
items.prompt: A turn-of-the-century laboratory bench, brass instruments, gauges and glass vessels, a single lamp, deep shadow around.

items.name: era09_logic_board
items.prompt: A dark lecture blackboard covered with faint chalk symbols and proof notation, a typewriter at the lower edge, raking light.

items.name: era10_machine
items.prompt: A cold computer hall, rows of dark server racks, faint network-like light traces on the floor, one distant blue glow.
